verified_facts.text: The hotel is at 973 Phloen Chit Road in Bangkok's Pathum Wan district.
verified_facts.excerpt: 973 Phloen Chit Road, Lumpini Pathum Wan Bangkok

verified_facts.text: The Erawan Shrine and Narayana Shrine are right in front of the hotel.
verified_facts.excerpt: explore the revered Erawan Shrine and Narayana Shrine right in front of the hotel

verified_facts.text: The hotel stands adjacent to the BTS Skytrain.
verified_facts.excerpt: InterContinental Bangkok provides unrivalled access to the city’s finest as it stands adjacent to the BTS Skytrain, Bangkok’s modern metro system.

verified_facts.text: The hotel is near the centralwOrld, Central Embassy and Siam Paragon shopping malls.
verified_facts.excerpt: InterContinental Bangkok is conveniently located near Bangkok's premier luxury shopping malls, including centralwOrld, Central Embassy, and Siam Paragon

verified_facts.text: Lumpini Park, Bangkok's largest park, is a short walk from the hotel.
verified_facts.excerpt: From the hotel, It’s only a short walk to Bangkok’s largest park.

verified_facts.text: Rooms and suites begin on Level 17 and all offer views of the Bangkok skyline.
verified_facts.excerpt: rooms and suites begin on Level 17, all offering stunning views of the Bangkok skyline

verified_facts.text: Rooms feature pastel-hued silk embroidered bedheads and custom-made furniture.
verified_facts.excerpt: The light-filled accommodations feature pastel-hued silk embroidered bedheads and custom-made furniture throughout.

verified_facts.text: Handcrafted artwork in the rooms showcases Thai floral welcoming traditions, with floating flowers as a design feature.
verified_facts.excerpt: Handcrafted artwork showcases Thai floral welcoming traditions, with floating flowers also a prominent design feature in the accommodations.

verified_facts.text: Bathrooms feature deep soaking tubs and separate rain showers.
verified_facts.excerpt: bathrooms feature deep soaking tubs and separate rain showers for ultimate relaxation

verified_facts.text: Suites feature Chopard bathroom amenities.
verified_facts.excerpt: Swiss luxury brand Chopard bathroom amenities are featured in Junior Suite, Premier Suite, Executive Suite, Ambassador Suite, Diplomatic Suite, and Royal Suite.

verified_facts.text: The Club InterContinental Lounge is on Level 37 with skyline views.
verified_facts.excerpt: Club InterContinental Lounge on Level 37, showcasing stunning skyline views

verified_facts.text: Club-access rooms and suites include private check-in at the Club InterContinental Lounge.
verified_facts.excerpt: followed by a warm welcome and private check-in at the Club InterContinental Lounge

verified_facts.text: The hotel has a free-form rooftop pool 37 stories above the city.
verified_facts.excerpt: Dive into relaxation at InterContinental Bangkok’s rooftop pool, a serene oasis 37 stories above the bustling city. Enjoy a refreshing swim in the free-form pool while soaking in panoramic views.

verified_facts.text: The Oasis Pool Bar serves cocktails and light bites by the rooftop pool.
verified_facts.excerpt: Unwind with signature cocktails and light bites from the Oasis Pool Bar

verified_facts.text: SPA InterContinental is set high above the city, and each of its nine treatment rooms has views of Bangkok.
verified_facts.excerpt: Perched high above the city, each of our nine luxurious treatment rooms offers breathtaking views of Bangkok.

verified_facts.text: Spa signature treatments use Elemis products.
verified_facts.excerpt: complemented by signature treatments using Elemis products

verified_facts.text: Infinity Fitness has cardio machines, a boxing ring, resistance training and a stretching zone, all with city views.
verified_facts.excerpt: Infinity Fitness at InterContinental Bangkok offers state-of-the-art cardio machines, a boxing ring, resistance training, and a stretching zone, all with panoramic city views.

verified_facts.text: Fireplace Grill and Bar has served guests since 1966 and has an open show kitchen.
verified_facts.excerpt: Since 1966, InterContinental Bangkok Fireplace Grill and Bar has defined fine dining in Bangkok legendary Ratchaprasong District surrounding Siam.

verified_facts.text: Summer Palace serves Cantonese cuisine and offers an all-you-can-eat dim sum option.
verified_facts.excerpt: Summer Palace is a long standing and widely acclaimed Bangkok favourite for Cantonese specialties, offering delightful a la carte selections and an all you can eat dim sum option.

verified_facts.text: Espresso hosts a seafood brunch on Sundays.
verified_facts.excerpt: Sundays bring a spectacular seafood brunch

verified_facts.text: Balcony Lounge serves afternoon tea and has live jazz at night.
verified_facts.excerpt: As night falls, the air fills with the sultry melodies of live jazz

verified_facts.text: Humidor is a cigar lounge with aged whiskies.
verified_facts.excerpt: Step into Humidor, an exquisite hideaway cigar lounge, where the allure of the finest aged whiskies and the rich aroma of premium cigars await

verified_facts.text: Parking in the indoor car park is complimentary for in-house guests.
verified_facts.excerpt: Complimentary for in-house guests

verified_facts.text: Pets are not allowed, but a kennel can be organized off premises on advance request.
verified_facts.excerpt: Pets are not allowed. However, a suitable kennel may be organized off premises on advance request.

verified_facts.text: The hotel is a single-use plastic free hotel.
verified_facts.excerpt: Single-use plastic free hotel
